request: i buy a monthly prepaid pack and always forget when it ends. type the day i bought it, how many days it lasts and its price. show the expiry date, days left today, a bar of days used and what each day costs
program:
app "Pack Expiry" phone green
state bought date = today - 12
state valid num = 30
state price money = 1200
let expiry = bought + valid
let left = max(expiry - today, 0)
field bought "Bought on"
"Valid for" valid "days" faint
slider valid 1..365
field price "Price"
"Expires on" expiry big
goal min(valid - left, valid), valid, "days used", "d"
row gap 2
  statcard left, "days left"
  statcard round(price / max(valid, 1) * 100) / 100, "per day"
if left = 0
  "This pack has expired. Time to buy again." bold color bad
if left > 0 and left <= 3
  "Ends soon. Renew in" plural(left, "day") faint color warn

request: courier price
checklist: 2. rate for first half kilo and each extra half kilo
program:
app "Courier Price" package orange
state kg num = 2.3
state first money = 250
state extra money = 100
state zone pick Same_city|Other_city|Far_area = Other_city
state fuel num = 8
let halves = max(floor((kg * 2 + 0.99)), 1)
let mult = if(zone = Same_city, 1, if(zone = Other_city, 1.4, 2))

field kg "Parcel weight (kg)"
row gap 1
  "Zone" faint
  choice zone
section "Courier rates"
  field first "First half kilo"
  field extra "Each extra half kilo"
  "Fuel surcharge" fuel "%" faint

statcard round(price), "to post this parcel"
"Charged as" halves "half kilos" faint

request: planning a race. pick 5k, 10k or half marathon, type my goal time in minutes, and show the pace per km and a split for every kilometre so i know my time at each marker

"per kilometre" faint

request: festival sale has 20 percent off the tag and then another 10 percent off at the counter for card holders. i type the tag price and both percents and want the final price, rupees saved, and the real total discount because its not 30
program:
app "Stacked Discounts" tag teal
state tag money = 0
state d1 num = 20
state d2 num = 10
let after1 = tag * (1 - d1 / 100)
let final = after1 * (1 - d2 / 100)
let real = if(tag > 0, (tag - final) * 100 / tag, 100 - (100 - d1) * (100 - d2) / 100)
field tag "Tag price"
"First discount" d1 "%" faint
slider d1 0..70
"Counter discount" d2 "%" faint
slider d2 0..50
statcard round(final), "you pay"
row gap 2
  statcard round(tag - final), "saved"
  statcard round(real * 10) / 10, "real discount, percent"
"After the first cut:" round(after1) faint

request: the recipe is for an 8 inch round pan but i only have a 10 inch one. pick the pan sizes and show how much bigger the area is and what to multiply every ingredient by
checklist: 5. a note when the batter will be too thin
program:
app "Pan Swap" food red
state recipe num = 8
state mine num = 10
let areaa = pi * pow(recipe / 2, 2)
let areab = pi * pow(mine / 2, 2)
let mult = if(areaa > 0, areab / areaa, 0)
field recipe "Pan in the recipe (inches)"
slider recipe 4..14
field mine "Pan I have (inches)"
slider mine 4..14
statcard round(mult * 100) / 100, "multiply every ingredient by"
row gap 2
  "Recipe pan" round(areaa) "sq in" faint
  "My pan" round(areab) "sq in" faint
if mult < 0.8
  "Your pan is much smaller, so the batter will be deep. Bake longer and check the middle." faint
if mult > 1.3
  "The pan is much larger, so scale up and bake a little shorter." faint
